items.prompt:
Which process removes carbon dioxide from the atmosphere?
A) Photosynthesis
B) Cellular respiration
C) Burning fuel
D) Erosion

Which process releases carbon dioxide into the atmosphere?
A) Photosynthesis
B) Cellular respiration
C) Freezing
D) Nothing

Carbon cycles among the biosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, and
A) geosphere
B) sun
C) moon
D) nothing

steps: Carbon moves among these four systems.

items.prompt:
Photosynthesis stores carbon in
A) sugars in living things
B) pure oxygen
C) sound waves
D) sunlight

Burning fossil fuels affects the carbon cycle by
A) releasing stored carbon as carbon dioxide into the air
B) removing carbon from the air
C) making oxygen only
D) stopping the cycle
items.answer: A) releasing stored carbon as carbon dioxide into the air

steps: Burning adds carbon dioxide to the atmosphere.

items.prompt:
Carbon moves from a plant into an animal when
A) the animal eats the plant
B) the plant breathes
C) it rains
D) the sun shines
items.answer: A) the animal eats the plant

steps: Eating moves carbon from plant to animal.

items.prompt:
Photosynthesis and respiration move carbon
A) in opposite directions, forming a cycle
B) only out of living things
C) only into the air
D) nowhere
items.answer: A) in opposite directions, forming a cycle

steps: Photosynthesis removes and respiration returns carbon.

items.prompt:
As carbon cycles among Earth's systems, the carbon atoms are
A) not destroyed, just moved into different molecules and places
B) destroyed
C) created from nothing
D) turned into oxygen permanently
items.answer: A) not destroyed, just moved into different molecules and places

steps: Carbon atoms cycle, they are not destroyed.
